what: silence.py, when nothing sat below --threshold, suggested the track's mean level + 6 dB as the next --threshold. The mean of a talk is the speech, so on a 20 s talk whose room hiss peaks near -30 dBFS (the default -35 finds no pause) the hint said --threshold -9, and that call removed 18.8 of the 20 s. A model that follows the hint gets a wrong result and spends its next calls recovering; #684's model ran out of its 20 calls on this request in every build. The hint also sat after `commands` and `probe`, where a reader of the first lines does not see it.
escaped: The hint was never followed in a test: no test ran the command a hint names and measured what it did. docs/stumbles.jsonl had the case as an open `default_misses` line (the room above the default threshold), and its replay only handled refusals, so an `open` line was never run.
mechanism: The suggestion is measured with the quantity silencedetect compares: the peak of the quietest --min-silence stretch (astats per 1024-sample block, one decode, only when nothing was found), + 3 dB. emit puts a result's `hint` third, after status and wrote, for every tool. The stumble ledger replays a `default_misses` line: StumbleLedgerTests.assert_the_hint_is_the_way_out runs the call, reads the --threshold from its hint, runs that, and measures that the four pauses go and the talk stays; the line is `taught` now, so any later default_misses line is replayed the same way. Class claim (a sentence the result states, here a suggested value, that the code path does not make true); its guard, test_guards.SweepGuards.test_a_result_never_says_less_than_the_output_lost, compares outputs, not suggestions, so the replayed stumble line is the check for a hint.
siblings: metadata.py --auto-chapters detects pauses with the same silencedetect and default -35 on --silence-threshold; on the same {room} talk it proposes one chapter and suggests a shorter --silence-min and --from both, not a threshold (no wrong value, a missing one). Swept with tests/sweep.py on the {room} talk against the same talk with a quiet room; recorded in the PR, not changed here.
